options: A living animal in a rock
Preserved remains or traces of past life
A type of rock
A mineral crystal
optionsAf: Bewaarde oorblyfsels of spore van vorige lewe
items.explain: Fossils are remains or traces of organisms that lived long ago, preserved in rock.
items.explainAf: Fossiele is oorblyfsels of spore van organismes wat lank gelede gelewe het, in rots bewaar.

items.q: Fossils of marine shells are found high up in a mountain. What does this suggest?
items.qAf: Fossiele van seeskulpe word hoog in ’n berg gevind. Wat suggereer dit?
options: The mountain was always dry land
The rock layers were once under the sea
Shells grow on mountains
The mountain is a volcano
optionsAf: Die berg was altyd droë land
Die gesteentelae was eens onder die see
items.explain: Marine fossils high up show that the land was once under the sea, and it has since been uplifted.
items.explainAf: Mariene fossiele hoog op wys dat die land eens onder die see was, en dat dit sedertdien opgelig is.

items.q: Which fossils are most useful for dating a rock layer?
items.qAf: Watter fossiele is die nuttigste om ’n gesteentelaag te date?
options: Index fossils of species that lived for a short time over a wide area
Fossils of plants that never changed
Any fossil in the top layer only
Fossils of animals found in ice
optionsAf: Indeksfossiele van spesies wat kort tyd oor ’n groot gebied geleef het
Fossiele van plante wat nooit verander het nie
Enige fossiel in die boonste laag alleen
Fossiele van diere wat in ys gevind word
items.explain: Index fossils identify a particular time period because the species existed briefly but widely.
items.explainAf: Indeksfossiele identifiseer ’n bepaalde tydperk omdat die spesies kort maar wyd bestaan het.

items.q: What is the law of superposition?
items.qAf: Wat is die wet van superposisie?
options: Older rock layers are on top
In undisturbed layers, the oldest layer is at the bottom
Rocks get younger with depth
All layers are the same age
optionsAf: In ongesteurde lae is die oudste laag onderaan
items.explain: In undisturbed rock layers, each layer is older than the one above it.
items.explainAf: In ongesteurde gesteentelae is elke laag ouer as die een daarbo.

items.q: A fault cuts through three rock layers. Which is the youngest feature?
items.qAf: ŉ Breuk sny deur drie gesteentelae. Watter kenmerk is die jongste?
options: The three layers
The fault
The bottom layer
The oldest fossil
items.explain: A fault cuts through existing layers, so it must be younger than the layers it cuts.
items.explainAf: ŉ Breuk sny deur bestaande lae, so dit moet jonger wees as die lae wat dit sny.

items.q: Why is the rock layer at the bottom of a sequence considered the oldest?
items.qAf: Waarom word die gesteentelaag onderaan ’n reeks as die oudste beskou?
options: Because it is the heaviest
Because layers are deposited one on top of the other over time
Because it is the hottest
Because it has no fossils
optionsAf: Omdat lae mettertyd een bo die ander afgeset word
Omdat dit geen fossiele het nie
items.explain: Sediments settle in order, so the lowest layers were laid down first.
items.explainAf: Sedimente setel in volgorde, so die laagste lae is eerste afgeset.

items.q: The preserved remains or traces of an organism that lived long ago.
items.qAf: Die bewaarde oorblyfsels of spore van ’n organisme wat lank gelede geleef het.

items.q: The type of rock in which most fossils are found.
items.qAf: Die soort rots waarin die meeste fossiele gevind word.

items.q: When a species dies out completely.

items.text: In undisturbed layers of rock, the [[]] layers are at the bottom and the [[]] layers are at the top.
items.textAf: In onversteurde rotslae is die [[]] lae onder en die [[]] lae bo.

items.text: The age of fossils can be worked out by [[]] dating. The dinosaurs died out about [[]] million years ago.
items.textAf: Die ouderdom van fossiele kan deur [[]] datering bepaal word. Die dinosourusse het omtrent [[]] miljoen jaar gelede uitgesterf.

items.q: Fossils of the coelacanth were known before living ones were found off South Africa in 1938.
items.qAf: Fossiele van die selakant was bekend voordat lewendes in 1938 aan die kus van Suid-Afrika gevind is.
items.explain: True. The coelacanth was thought to be extinct until one was caught near East London.
items.explainAf: Waar. Daar is gedink die selakant is uitgesterf totdat een naby Oos-Londen gevang is.

items.q: Fossils usually form in igneous rock.
items.explain: False. The heat of magma would destroy the remains; fossils form in sedimentary rock.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Die hitte van magma sou die oorblyfsels vernietig; fossiele vorm in sedimentêre gesteente.

items.q: The Karoo is famous for fossils of mammal-like reptiles.
items.qAf: Die Karoo is bekend vir fossiele van soogdieragtige reptiele.
items.explain: True. Karoo rocks contain many fossils from about 250 million years ago.
items.explainAf: Waar. Karoo-rotse bevat baie fossiele van omtrent 250 miljoen jaar gelede.

items.q: Put the steps of fossil formation in order.
items.qAf: Rangskik die stappe van fossielvorming in volgorde.
steps: It is quickly buried by sediment
Soft parts decay; hard parts remain
Minerals replace the bones over a long time
stepsAf: Dit word vinnig deur sediment begrawe
Sagte dele vergaan; harde dele bly oor
Minerale vervang die bene oor ’n lang tyd
